title: Senior Rust Engineer - Acme Ltd | Example Boards
text:
Senior Rust Engineer
Acme Ltd - London (Remote, UK only)
£90,000 - £110,000 per year

We are building payment infrastructure in Rust. You will own services end to end: design, implementation, deployment on AWS, and operations.

Requirements:
- 5+ years of production Rust
- Solid PostgreSQL experience
- Familiarity with event-driven architectures (Kafka a plus)
- Kubernetes exposure is nice to have

We offer a remote-first culture with quarterly meetups in London, private healthcare, and a learning budget.

Interview process: intro call, technical screen, take-home, system design, values interview, final chat with the CTO.
